disclosure: Phase-1 scripts only computed outcome statistics on TRAIN events (filter split=='train').
Seen outside TRAIN: total event COUNTS per type over the full file (engine log) and the median 1m ATR per calendar year (2025: 6.5 pts). No outcome, return or win-rate number of VAL/OOS was computed.

Earlier research sessions in this repository (other branches) used 2025 as holdout for OTHER hypotheses (NY-PM breakout, London open). 2025 is therefore unseen for level hypotheses, but not pristine for the research programme as a whole.
